title: Control systems and methods for vacuum lift equipment

features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
features.quote: The present invention is generally directed to vacuum lifting equipment used for moving materials and material handling More particularly, the present invention is directed to control systems, methods, and devices for controlling a vacuum attachment device or system used for
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum attachment device for lifting materials, which can be battery-powered and handheld, implying a cordless design.
features.refuted: The passage describes vacuum lifting equipment generally, not specifically a cordless handheld device with integrated battery power. It also doesn't mention 'cordless' or 'handheld'.

features.item: flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
features.quote: one or more vacuum pads each with a sealing edge and a face which resists sliding when pressed against a surface using the force generated by vacuum
features.note: The quote describes a 'sealing edge' on vacuum pads that creates a seal against a surface, which is equivalent to a flexible sealing lip.
features.refuted: The passage mentions 'sealing edge' and 'resists sliding' but does not explicitly describe a 'flexible sealing lip' or that it 'bounds sealed region against workpiece'.

features.item: electric vacuum pump mounted within rigid body to draw air from sealed region
features.quote: System 10 can include a vacuum source 12 and one or more vacuum pads 14 . A pneumatic line (i.e., conduit) 16 can connect vacuum pad(s) 14 with vacuum source 12 .
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum source, preferably an electric vacuum pump, connected to vacuum pads. While it doesn't explicitly state 'mounted within rigid body', the context of a 'system' and 'vacuum attachment device' implies integration.
features.refuted: The passage mentions a 'vacuum source' and 'vacuum pads' connected by a 'pneumatic line' but does not specify an 'electric vacuum pump mounted within rigid body' or that it 'draws air from sealed region'.

features.item: pressure sensor monitoring vacuum level in sealed region
features.quote: As shown schematically in FIG. 2 , a vacuum sensor 36 can measure the precise level of vacuum in the vacuum circuit and communicates that measurement to the programmable controller
features.note: The reference explicitly states a vacuum sensor measures the vacuum level in the vacuum circuit, which is the sealed region.

features.item: warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level
features.quote: If the vacuum level in a system drops to an identified vacuum level to ensure it does not drop below the threshold required for lifting. The level at which the supply is reengaged may be elevated above this threshold level
features.note: The reference describes re-engaging vacuum supply at a level elevated above the minimum lifting threshold, implying a warning could be triggered before reaching the absolute release level.
features.refuted: The passage describes re-engaging the supply when the vacuum drops to an identified level, and that this re-engagement level may be elevated above a threshold. It does not explicitly state a 'warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level'.

features.item: warning threshold defined relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum
features.quote: If the vacuum level in a system drops to an identified vacuum level to ensure it does not drop below the threshold required for lifting. The level at which the supply is reengaged may be elevated above this threshold level
features.note: The reference discusses a threshold 'required for lifting' and a re-engagement level 'elevated above this threshold', indicating a warning or action point relative to the critical lifting threshold.
features.refuted: The passage mentions a 'threshold required for lifting' but does not explicitly define a 'warning threshold relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum'.

features.item: warning indicator remains active while grip vacuum persists below threshold
features.quote: If the leak rate exceeds any of a number of thresholds, the operator can be warned with an urgency corresponding to the threshold that has been exceeded. Additionally, the leak rate may be displayed on the graphic display 22 .
features.note: The reference states that warnings are provided if a leak rate exceeds thresholds and can be displayed, implying the warning persists as long as the condition is met.
features.refuted: The passage describes warning the operator if the leak rate exceeds thresholds and displaying the leak rate. It does not state that the 'warning indicator remains active while grip vacuum persists below threshold'.

features.item: rechargeable battery integrated into rigid body powering vacuum pump
features.quote: System 10 can further include a battery 28 for providing power to the system 10
features.note: The reference describes a battery providing power to the system, and mentions 'battery charger 84 can be powered by line voltage enables charging of battery 28', indicating it is rechargeable. The context of a 'vacuum attachment device' implies it is integrated.
features.refuted: The passage states 'System 10 can further include a battery 28 for providing power to the system 10' but does not specify that it is 'rechargeable' or 'integrated into rigid body powering vacuum pump'.

features.item: warning indicator positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation
features.quote: If the requirements are not met, the operator can be notified by an indicator so that corrective action can be taken before attempting a lift.
features.note: The reference mentions an 'indicator' to notify the operator, and the context of a 'vacuum lifter' implies it would be visible during operation.
features.refuted: The passage states 'the operator can be notified by an indicator' but does not specify that the 'warning indicator is positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation'.

features.item: single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.quote: The present invention is generally directed to vacuum lifting equipment used for moving materials and material handling More particularly, the present invention is directed to control systems, methods, and devices for controlling a vacuum attachment device or system used for
features.note: The reference describes a 'vacuum attachment device' and 'vacuum lifter' that can be battery-powered, suggesting portability. However, it does not explicitly state 'single-hand portable design' or 'without external hose or cord' for all components, although it implies a self-contained unit.

overall.why: The reference describes a comprehensive control system for battery-powered vacuum lifting equipment, including high-resolution vacuum sensing, leak detection, battery condition monitoring, and various warning indicators, which aligns strongly with many features of the subject invention.
